author: GereonRath8888
quote:
This Game has been such a profound disappointment to me. I genuinely wanted this game to be good and waited and hoped for it only to restrict most of the things which make the game fun. 

1 : You cant bring your guns inside Nightclubs(I know it was the same in Gta 5 but you had workarounds for it)

2 : You cant Target NPCs who are activists or protesting in the open world which hollows and stips away the freedom which the player is supposed to have in the open world to have fun however they want.

3. You cant have sexual encounters with other women besides lucia even though this game is supposed to have a optional relationship but now allowing the player to choose other female NPCs makes a severe contradiction on supposed freedom the player is supposed to have to pursue a relationship with lucia.

5 : there are certain NPCs you arent able to target because they are "protected groups" like WTF? This is **** GTA , you are supposed to be a car hijacking murdering criminal but you cant commit crimes agaisnt some "special" NPCs because they are "protected groups" I mean what kind of world or game is Rockstar making this out to be?
Does Rockstar seriously not want players to have freedom and agency to curate and shape the open world to their will. Isnt this discriminatory to be able to shoot up the entire beach but not being able to do the same inside a **** nightclub or a strip club?

I hate this game because i feel like it restricts my freedom to have fun in a Open world game .

6 : There is a narrative which being pushed by Rockstar agaisnt players will which is very female centered and discriminatory to Men. **** hecause Gta is a Franchise Built by Men for Men.

Thank You For Reading if you did.
